title: F26 · cheated · The Friend Who Did Not Return It
lines: Two lakh rupees. Thirty-one calls. No answer.
They had been friends since school.
He replays every conversation, looking for the moment he was a fool.
Some nights he plans what he will say.
It always ends with him shouting, and nothing changing.
On the roof, he said it all out loud to nobody.
I forgave the man who cost me everything. It did not undo what he did. It gave me back my sleep.
Papa filed the complaint. That part was right.
He slept through the night for the first time in a month.
Go after what is yours. Put down what is burning you. That is sadhana.
